entries.b19ad6656ea05d48: This is a wholesale business handling food, liquor and other products. The group consists of a single segment, the food and liquor wholesale business and its ancillary businesses, and is composed of six subsidiaries and one affiliate. The consolidated subsidiaries are three companies: Tokan Co., Ltd., which engages in wholesale and processing of mainly food products; Kokubu Chubu Co., Ltd., which wholesales liquor and food; and Sankyu Co., Ltd., which wholesales food for institutional catering. It supplies products to sales channels such as supermarkets, restaurants, takeout and catering operators, convenience stores and drugstores, and operates chilled, temperature-controlled and ambient-temperature distribution centers mainly in the Tokai region. Consolidated net sales for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥366,060 million.
